correctness.rationale: The one-step descent identity ω(2−ω)r_i²/2 and the two conditional second-coordinate choices yield the exact expected-gap quadratic in normalized gradients. Its eigenvalues are a±2|c| and the critical minimum eigenvalue factors as (1−|c|)(2−ω(1+|c|)), proving the if-and-only-if frontier and explicit witnesses for all real SPD 2×2 Hessians. An independent exact-rational enumeration verifies 5880 checks, not used in place of the proof.

value.rationale: This completely classifies the smallest nontrivial SPD case of a motivated stochastic-SOR design choice: at fixed two gradient evaluations, shuffling ceases to uniformly dominate iid when overrelaxation exceeds 1+1/κ (normalized condition number), although every step still reduces objective. Both opposite comparisons occur at fixed matrix and parameter; the sharp boundary prevents an unjustified extension of established exact-minimization results.
